Kofi Mercer
kofi.mercer@example.com | Kansas City, MO
Kofi Mercer has 9 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Staff Backend Engineer at Anchor Labs (2024-2026), where they owned
the Kafka event pipeline processing 24M events/day. Before that, Senior Backend
Engineer at Meridian Solutions (2020-2024). Before that, Backend Engineer at
Palodex Technologies (2017-2020). Education: M.S. Computer Engineering,
University of Colorado Boulder, 2016; B.S. Computer Engineering, Virginia Tech,
2013. Core skills: Distributed systems, TypeScript, REST API design, Node.js,
PostgreSQL, Docker, Kafka, CI/CD.
